versions.changelog:
Initial release of changelog-curator.

- Provides a dedicated tool for compiling external-facing changelogs from commit logs and release notes.
- Distinguishes between user-facing changes and internal improvements.
- Outputs structured changelog sections: version summary, user-visible changes, internal changes, compatibility notes, upgrade advice, and known issues.
- Includes built-in safeguards: does not invent unreleased features or override approval processes, with recommendations for review and compliance.
- Offers local templates and examples for consistency and easy adoption.
